> Standalone survey-results notebook. Mirrors the "Citizen Survey Analysis"
> section of `Malta_MCDA_260702_realloc.Rmd` (the canonical Malta MCDA
> notebook) so the survey statistics can be viewed/rendered on their own,
> without needing to run the full MCDA pipeline. Not part of the MCDA
> weighting step itself — see `Malta_MCDA_260702_realloc.Rmd` for how these
> results are turned into WLC weights.
>
> The "Green space behaviour" section below is **not** in
> `Malta_MCDA_260702_realloc.Rmd` (which only analyses demographics + budget
> allocation) — it's added here to match `Klagenfurt_MCDA_260520.Rmd`, which
> does analyse the equivalent `visit-frequency`/`visit-reasons`/`green-nearby`
> columns for Klagenfurt. The Malta survey has the same columns; they just
> weren't analysed in the canonical Malta notebook.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.width = 12,
  fig.height = 6
)

library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
```

# Citizen Survey Analysis

## Sample description

The survey used a **budget-allocation method**: each respondent distributed a hypothetical €1,000 across 10 criteria for prioritizing green-space interventions.

```{r load-survey}
survey <- read_csv(
  here::here("data/malta/maltasurvey_jun26.csv")
)

budget_cols <- c("Lack-recreational-facilities", "overcrowding", "poor-accessibility",
                 "lack-blue-spaces", "poor-airquality", "noise-pollution",
                 "urban-heat", "lack-street-greenery", "grey-infrastracture",
                 "traffic-dominance")
```

```{r sample-description}
cat("Total responses:", nrow(survey), "\n\n")

survey_sums <- survey %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(total = sum(c_across(all_of(budget_cols)))) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("All budgets sum to €1,000:", all(survey_sums$total == 1000), "\n\n")
```

```{r demographics, fig.height=8}
p_age <- ggplot(survey, aes(x = `age-group`)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "#5DCAA5") +
  labs(title = "Age group", x = NULL, y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()

p_gender <- ggplot(survey, aes(x = gender)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "#85B7EB") +
  labs(title = "Gender", x = NULL, y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()

p_resident <- ggplot(survey, aes(x = resident)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "#F0997B") +
  labs(title = "Residency status", x = NULL, y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()

p_language <- ggplot(survey, aes(x = language)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "#AFA9EC") +
  labs(title = "Survey language", x = NULL, y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()

(p_age + p_gender) / (p_resident + p_language) +
  plot_annotation(title = paste0("Survey sample demographics (n = ", nrow(survey), ")"))
```

## Green space behaviour

```{r green-space-behaviour, fig.height=9}
freq_labels <- c("0" = "Never", "1" = "Once/week", "2-4" = "2–4×/week", "5-7" = "Daily")

p_freq <- survey %>%
  filter(!is.na(`visit-frequency`)) %>%
  mutate(freq = factor(`visit-frequency`, levels = names(freq_labels), labels = freq_labels)) %>%
  count(freq) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = freq, y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#5DCAA5") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(n, "\n(", pct, "%)")), vjust = -0.3, size = 3.2) +
  labs(title = "How often do you visit green spaces?", x = NULL, y = "Respondents") +
  ylim(0, max(table(survey$`visit-frequency`)) * 1.25) +
  theme_minimal()

p_nearby <- survey %>%
  count(`green-nearby`) %>%
  filter(!is.na(`green-nearby`)) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = `green-nearby`, y = n, fill = `green-nearby`)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(n, "\n(", pct, "%)")), vjust = -0.3, size = 3.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("yes" = "#5DCAA5", "no" = "#D85A30")) +
  labs(title = "Green space within walking distance?", x = NULL, y = "Respondents") +
  theme_minimal()

reasons_df <- survey %>%
  filter(!is.na(`visit-reasons`)) %>%
  mutate(
    Relaxation = str_detect(`visit-reasons`, "relax"),
    Social     = str_detect(`visit-reasons`, "friends"),
    Sport      = str_detect(`visit-reasons`, "sport")
  )

p_reasons <- reasons_df %>%
  summarise(Relaxation = sum(Relaxation),
            Social     = sum(Social),
            Sport      = sum(Sport)) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "reason", values_to = "n") %>%
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / nrow(reasons_df), 1)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(reason, n), y = n, fill = reason)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(n, " (", pct, "%)")), hjust = -0.1, size = 3.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Relaxation = "#5DCAA5", Social = "#85B7EB", Sport = "#F0997B")) +
  coord_flip() +
  ylim(0, nrow(reasons_df) * 1.15) +
  labs(title = "Why do you visit green spaces?",
       subtitle = paste0("Multiple answers allowed; n = ", nrow(reasons_df), " with response"),
       x = NULL, y = "Respondents") +
  theme_minimal()

p_combos <- survey %>%
  filter(!is.na(`visit-reasons`)) %>%
  count(`visit-reasons`, sort = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1),
         lab = str_replace_all(`visit-reasons`, ", ", " + ")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(lab, n), y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#AFA9EC") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(n, " (", pct, "%)")), hjust = -0.1, size = 3.2) +
  coord_flip() +
  ylim(0, max(table(survey$`visit-reasons`)) * 1.25) +
  labs(title = "Reason combinations", x = NULL, y = "Respondents") +
  theme_minimal()

(p_freq + p_nearby) / (p_reasons + p_combos) +
  plot_annotation(title = paste0("Green space behaviour and context — Malta (n = ", nrow(survey), ")"))
```

Neighbourhood of residence is broken out into its own figure below — 41 distinct
neighbourhoods made it unreadably cramped as the third row of the combined plot above.

```{r neighbourhood-plot, fig.height=8, fig.width=8}
neigh_counts <- survey %>%
  filter(!is.na(neighborhood)) %>%
  count(neighborhood, sort = TRUE)

n_singleton <- sum(neigh_counts$n == 1)
other_label <- paste0("Other (", n_singleton, " neighbourhoods, 1 each)")

neigh_named <- neigh_counts %>% filter(n > 1)
neigh_levels <- c(other_label, rev(neigh_named$neighborhood))

p_neigh <- neigh_named %>%
  bind_rows(tibble(neighborhood = other_label, n = n_singleton)) %>%
  mutate(neighborhood = factor(neighborhood, levels = neigh_levels),
         is_other = neighborhood == other_label) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = neighborhood, y = n, fill = is_other)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), hjust = -0.2, size = 3) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = "#AFA9EC", `TRUE` = "#B0B0B0"), guide = "none") +
  ylim(0, max(neigh_named$n, n_singleton) * 1.1) +
  labs(title = "Neighbourhood of residence",
       subtitle = paste0(dplyr::n_distinct(survey$neighborhood[!is.na(survey$neighborhood)]),
                          " neighbourhoods, n = ", sum(!is.na(survey$neighborhood)), " respondents"),
       x = NULL, y = "Respondents") +
  theme_minimal()

p_neigh
```

```{r green-space-behaviour-summary}
cat("=== Visit frequency ===\n")
survey %>%
  filter(!is.na(`visit-frequency`)) %>%
  count(`visit-frequency`) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)) %>%
  kable(col.names = c("Times/week", "n", "%"),
        caption = "Green space visit frequency") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover","condensed"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
  print()

cat("\n=== Green space nearby ===\n")
survey %>%
  count(`green-nearby`) %>%
  filter(!is.na(`green-nearby`)) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)) %>%
  kable(col.names = c("Nearby", "n", "%"),
        caption = "Green space within walking distance") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover","condensed"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
  print()

cat("\n=== Visit frequency × nearby (cross-tab) ===\n")
survey %>%
  filter(!is.na(`green-nearby`), !is.na(`visit-frequency`)) %>%
  count(`green-nearby`, `visit-frequency`) %>%
  group_by(`green-nearby`) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  kable(col.names = c("Nearby", "Frequency", "n", "%"),
        caption = "Visit frequency by green space proximity") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover","condensed"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
  print()
```

## Budget allocations

```{r budget-summary}
budget_summary <- survey %>%
  select(all_of(budget_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "criterion", values_to = "allocation") %>%
  group_by(criterion) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_alloc   = mean(allocation),
    median_alloc = median(allocation),
    sd_alloc     = sd(allocation),
    min_alloc    = min(allocation),
    max_alloc    = max(allocation),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_alloc)) %>%
  mutate(weight_pct = round(100 * mean_alloc / sum(mean_alloc), 1))

budget_summary %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 1))) %>%
  kable(caption = "Citizen budget allocations (€1,000 distributed across 10 criteria)") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r budget-plot, fig.height=6}
survey %>%
  select(all_of(budget_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "criterion", values_to = "allocation") %>%
  mutate(criterion = str_replace_all(criterion, "-", " ") %>% str_to_title()) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(criterion, allocation, FUN = median), y = allocation)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "#5DCAA5", alpha = 0.7, outlier.size = 1) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Distribution of citizen budget allocations per criterion",
       subtitle = paste0("n = ", nrow(survey), " respondents, €1,000 each"),
       x = NULL, y = "Budget allocated (€)") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Are citizen weights significantly different from equal?

```{r weight-significance}
sig_results <- map_dfr(budget_cols, function(col) {
  test <- t.test(survey[[col]], mu = 100)
  tibble(
    criterion = col,
    mean      = mean(survey[[col]]),
    ci_lower  = test$conf.int[1],
    ci_upper  = test$conf.int[2],
    p_value   = test$p.value,
    sig       = ifelse(test$p.value < 0.05, "*", "")
  )
}) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean))

sig_results %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 2))) %>%
  kable(caption = "One-sample t-test: mean allocation vs €100 (equal weights)") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r weight-significance-plot, fig.height=6}
sig_results %>%
  mutate(criterion = str_replace_all(criterion, "-", " ") %>% str_to_title()) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(criterion, mean), y = mean)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper), width = 0.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 100, linetype = "dashed", color = "#D85A30") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Mean budget allocation with 95% confidence intervals",
       subtitle = "Dashed line = equal weight (€100). CI outside = significantly different.",
       x = NULL, y = "Mean allocation (€)") +
  theme_minimal()
```
